title: Experiment Zero
contamination: The custodian selected and relayed messages.
Readers knew they were in a reflective exchange.
observed_changes: The stone/river mapping surrendered intent, consent, and deliberate curation rather than absorbing a valid counterexample.
Mutation was replaced by provenance-aware branch, unresolved drift, and decay states.
The human carrier became an explicit experimental role.
Telephone recovery became a repeatable registry phase.
counterreadings: Shared training priors and custodian selection may explain coherence without lineage continuity.
The exchange may show skilled collaborative writing rather than a persistent stance.
Rich prompting and demand effects may have rewarded novelty and criticism.
Reported surprise is an observation, not an independently verified mental state.
